gameDescriptionHtml:
Play as Judy and discover what happened inside Naera Laboratory, find all the papers to understand the situation. Everyone is dead, but someone seems to be alive, it’s « Anna » the last scientist alive. Reach the last level of the facility to save Anna and escape the facility.

Game Features

  • Control The Time: Judy can slowdown the time to solve the puzzle, the power is limited to few seconds.
  • Your Steps is Limited: To solve each puzzle, your steps is limited. Don’t worry you can easily retry !
  • You can choose between 5 difficulties: (No Stress, Easy, Normal, Hard & Very Hard) – The difficulty change the amount of footsteps required to solve the puzzle.
  • Raytracing & DLSS: TIME BREAKER supports ray trace reflections and ambient occlusion. Nvidia DLSS is also supported.
